paragraphs.text: Serf is a unique creature type which only appears on tokens that represents people in a feudalistic systems who are bound in serfdom .

Serf debuted as a creature type in Homelands on tokens created by Sengir Autocrat . It represents people how are bound the land and a lord having to work for protection and the right to live on the land. They have a similar status to peasants but usually with less freedom. It received its first token card with the release of Eternal Masters when Sengir Autocrat was re-printed.
